Orderpicker - Echt - 
 €15.16 per hour - Logistics - 38 hour 
We are looking for motivated employees who want to work as an Orderpicker at Action in Echt. Are you interested? Read on now! 
As an Orderpicker at Action you have a diverse function. You ensure that the correct goods are ready for shipment on time and completely so that they can be brought to the stores by the drivers. You do this by collecting the articles that are passed on via the voice pick system. You will stack, pack, seal, label, sort and prepare the roll containers and place them on the correct dock. You also identify, register and correct deviations in outgoing orders. You drive around on a truck and you work with the latest technology. The voice pick system is available in Dutch, English or Polish. 
You work an average of 38 hours a week. There are two shifts: the first starts at 06:00 and the second starts at 15:15. End times are flexible. On Saturdays there is only a morning shift. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as an Orderpicker. 
 Job Requirements 
 - At least 18 years old - You speak communicational English - Approachable and accurate - Team player - You want to work for a longer period of time 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation - Organized transport to work - Weekly payments - During the afternoon shift you get a free evening meal - Additional allowances: 125% between 20:00 and 24:00, and 150% between 00:00 and 06:00 - Travel allowance from 11 km 
 About the company 
 The company you will be working for is a well-known retail chain: Action. They have over 1,700 stores in Europe. The stores in Belgium and Germany in particular are supplied from the distribution center in Echt.
